evidence: Complete stationary diagnostic soak with selected same-sample physical timing witnesses
transformation: Original complete wire bytes, gzip mtime=0. Scope publishes derived counts/extrema/clock scales only. Metadata uses an explicit allowlist. Diagnostic scope subset is explicitly declared; every retained firmware witness and predecessor is included.

scope.representation: All physical service pulses; per-second counts and extrema checked, no individual sample replay

limits: One fixture and declared stationary workload. Aggregates with selected witnesses do not retain every individual observation or prove pickup/gesture behavior during movement. Digital-only scope; analog preflights are separate. Synthetic callback padding, not production DSP or audio-quality qualification. Host pacing is best effort; reported quality failures remain failures. CPU GPIO brackets are diagnostic observations, not pad-transition guarantees. Selected witnesses are not a full trace. A new passing run does not resolve an earlier unexplained failure.

timing.selection: Every retained timing witness and predecessor. Original sample sequence numbers; scope times subtract the first acquisition rise. Other physical pulses are omitted, not reconstructed.
